entry.title: New: Resolution 529 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Postponed
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE UNIVERSITY OF HAWAI‘I, HAWAI‘I COMMUNITY COLLEGE, PURSUANT TO SECTION 46-7, HAWAIʻI REVISED STATUTES

Allows for students in Hawaiʻi Community College’s Fire Science Program to participate in hands-on learning opportunities and experiences facilitated by the Hawaiʻi Fire Department, and Hawaiʻi Fire Department personnel to earn college credits and accreditation when completing training that includes college level learning.

Latest action: GOEAC: Postponed to the Call of the Chair - 06/04/24; never taken up again.
